parsed.evidence_quote: Proteins were digested by on-pellet trypsin digestion. Briefly, 25 µl trypsin (4 µg/ml ...)
After completion of the reaction, trypsin was added ... let to react 16 h at 37ºC.
followed by incubation with 500 mM iodoacetamide (1h, room temperature, dark, 300 rpm).
iodoacetamide was added to the sample to a final concentration of 20 mM and let to react for 30 min
Proteins were precipitated ... and re-dissolved ... After precipitation, proteins were digested by on-pellet trypsin digestion.
incubated with 2% periodic acid (3 h, room temperature, dark, 300 rpm) and DSP fixated tissue was incubated with 250 mM DTT (2h, room temperature, 300 rpm)
parsed.note: The Methods report room temperature for the cleavage/incubation steps (periodic acid for DST and DTT/iodoacetamide for DSP), not explicitly for the initial crosslinking reaction itself.
